select.empty.heading: No compatible printers
select.empty.note: None of the printers you may use takes a file for this printer model.
select.multipleBeds: Your project has more than one bed. Pick the printer for the first bed. Only the first bed prints: this server has no print queue, so the printer refuses the other beds while it prints.
select.noPrinter: Pick a printer that can print now
select.none.heading: No printers
select.none.note: You may use no printer on this server. Ask its administrator for access to a printer.
select.outside.heading: This page is for PrusaSlicer
select.outside.note: PrusaSlicer 3 opens it when you send a file to a printer of this server.
select.problem.filamentAbrasive: The material is abrasive and the nozzle is not hardened
select.problem.nozzleHighFlow: The print needs a high-flow nozzle
select.problem.printerModel: The file is for another printer model
select.sent: PrusaSlicer sends the file to the printer now.
select.title: Print
select.waiting: Waiting for PrusaSlicer to say which printer the file needs
howTo.title: How to
howTo.perServer: PrusaSlicer 3 Connector is set up once, in PrusaSlicer, for the whole server.
howTo.steps.services: In PrusaSlicer 3, open Preferences, then Services. Set the mode to offline and paste this server's address.
howTo.steps.signIn: Sign in. PrusaSlicer shows a code, and you approve it on this server's pairing page.
howTo.steps.print: The Connect tab then lists the printers you may see. Send a print from its print dialog.
howTo.steps.more: The sign-in is listed under Settings, API credentials, where you can revoke it.
howTo.limits: The largest upload is set for the whole server, on the Uploads tab.
